description: Source code for the SPI interface of the STMicroelectronics LIS2DH 3-axis accelerometer driver in Zephyr RTOS.

methods.name: lis2dh_raw_read
methods.description: Reads raw data from the device registers over SPI.

methods.name: lis2dh_raw_write
methods.description: Writes raw data to the device registers over SPI.

methods.name: lis2dh_spi_read_data
methods.description: Reads data from the device via SPI.

methods.name: lis2dh_spi_write_data
methods.description: Writes data to the device via SPI.

methods.name: lis2dh_spi_read_reg
methods.description: Reads a register value over SPI.

methods.name: lis2dh_spi_write_reg
methods.description: Writes a value to a register over SPI.

methods.name: lis2dh_spi_update_reg
methods.description: Updates specific bits in a register over SPI.

methods.name: lis2dh_spi_init
methods.description: Initializes the SPI interface for the LIS2DH device.
